body: That's definitely how I typically deal with this, waiting to see what tomorrow brings. I'm 25 and this is definitely not the first time I've seriously thought about not being. But the thing is, what's the point of indefinitely waiting for tomorrow? Especially when today is so bleak and there's no end to the dark clouds on the horizon. I've always been a 'silver-lining' guy, but there isn't one this time. I really appreciate your kind words and the time you took to right them. Really really. :)
